nphi.title: BE READY – European Research Partnership for pandemic preparedness (CSA)
nphi.actor: AGES – Austrian Agency for Health and Food Safety
nphi.with: ANRS-MIE; Statens Serum Institut; NIPH Norway; NIZP-PZH; Laboratoire national de santé; ISS; RIVM; UKRI
nphi.summary: Coordination and support action preparing a European pandemic-preparedness research partnership with a One Health approach; partners include Norway and the UK.

nphi.title: XBM:TB phase 2 – Cross-border tuberculosis management Germany–Poland–Moldova–Romania
nphi.with: Institute of Tuberculosis and Lung Diseases (Warsaw, Poland); 'Chiril Draganiuc' Institute of Pneumology (Chișinău, Moldova); 'Marius Nasta' Institute of Pneumology (Bucharest, Romania)
nphi.summary: Structured information-exchange protocols to keep TB treatment continuous for patients moving between Germany and partner countries and to monitor outcomes.

nphi.title: Ukraine–Poland agreement on cooperation in public health (border exercises, epidemiological data exchange)
nphi.with: Chief State Sanitary Doctor of Ukraine / Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: December 2025 agreement between the two chief sanitary officers on IHR implementation, infectious-disease data exchange, joint border-region preparedness, training and alignment with EU standards, including lab diagnostics and AMR.

nphi.title: JADE Health – Joint Action addressing Dementia and Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on dementia with 17 countries including Norway and Ukraine; Slovenian pilot on awareness and stigma reduction.

nphi.title: JANE-2 – Joint Action on Networks of Expertise
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori (lead); beneficiaries in 16 countries incl. Norway
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on networks of expertise with 16 beneficiary countries including Norway; NIJZ is the Slovenian representative.

nphi.title: XBM:TB – Cross-border TB management Poland–Germany
nphi.with: National Tuberculosis and Lung Disease Research Institute (IGiChP), Poland
nphi.summary: One-year preparatory project to improve information exchange on TB patients and contacts crossing the Polish-German border.

nphi.title: IANPHI Europe mission to the Poland–Ukraine border
nphi.summary: In May 2022, Poland's NPHI invited an IANPHI Europe delegation to visit refugee reception sites on the Ukrainian border. The mission produced a report with recommendations.

nphi.title: 2022 IANPHI Europe Annual Meeting (Tallinn)
nphi.actor: National Institute for Health Development (TAI), Estonia
nphi.with: IANPHI Europe member NPHIs; Public Health Center of Ukraine (assisted under network workplan)
nphi.summary: TAI hosted the 2022 IANPHI Europe meeting with over 60 participants; the network's workplan included assisting Ukraine's Public Health Center after a May 2022 mission to Poland.

nphi.title: Joint WHO Europe–IANPHI seminars on building NPHIs through mergers
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Regional Office for Europe; merged NPHIs of Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden, UK
nphi.summary: WHO Europe and IANPHI held three seminars, in Kyiv (2017), Warsaw (2018) and Moldova (April 2019). Merged NPHIs from Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden and the UK shared their experience with countries setting up NPHIs: Ukraine, Moldova,…
